blob: features of manufacturing parts using additive technologies from metal alloys. an analytical review this article explores current scientific research on the machining process of parts manufactured using additive technologies. the paper presents a brief classification of metal alloys used in the field of additive manufacturing, as well as a classification of 3d printing technologies known to date. the opportunities provided by additive technologies are outlined. the advantages and disadvantages of additive manufacturing in general, and of the most common production methods in particular, are di 此综述涉及增材制造ti-6al-4v零件的机械加工，但未定量研究后处理对疲劳/力学性能的影响。 this is a review that discusses machinability of am ti-6al-4v but does not provide experimental mechanical data or a specific post-processing effect on fatigue/tensile performance. 综述增材制造金属零件加工现状，指出ti6al4v加工研究不足。 文献综述，分类金属合金与3d打印技术，分析层取向和微观结构对加工的影响。 强调后加工不可替代，需研究ti6al4v特定打印方法的铣削工艺。 无实验验证，仅文献总结。 additive manufacturing machining ti-6al-4v review additive manufacturing 增材制造 machining 机械加工 ti-6al-4v ti-6al-4v钛合金 layer orientation 层取向 microstructure anisotropy 微观结构各向异性 machinability 可加工性 finish machining 精加工 review 综述 oles sonets, borys vorontsov mechanics and advanced technologies national technical university of ukraine “igor sikorsky kyiv polytechnic institute”

blob: analytical modeling of grain size prediction in additive manufacturing abstract additive manufacturing has been broadly employed to create geometrically complex parts, where processing parameters significantly influence the resulting parts’ materials microstructure and properties. however, additive manufacturing still faces limitations such as anisotropic microstructure and mechanical properties, restrictions on material selection, defects, and high cost. grain size, usually quantitatively represented by mean grain diameter, is a vital microstructure feature closel 该论文针对ti-6al-4v合金建立了晶粒尺寸分析模型，与力学性能间接相关，可用于工艺-结构-性能预测。 the paper focuses on grain size prediction modeling rather than direct mechanical or fatigue characterization; no tensile or fatigue data are reported. 增材制造ti-6al-4v晶粒尺寸的精确预测模型缺乏，尤其是考虑热-力耦合及织构的物理模型。 建立包含热模型、jmak动力学、cet模型及vpsc自洽方法的晶粒尺寸分析模型，并用ti-6al-4v验证。 晶粒尺寸预测与实验数据平均吻合度93.03%，工业相关扫描速度下达97.01%，较前人模型平均提升23.8%。 与文献中ti-6al-4v实验晶粒尺寸数据对比验证。 ti-6al-4v grain size analytical modeling microstructure additive manufacturing additive manufacturing 增材制造 ti-6al-4v ti-6al-4v合金 grain size 晶粒尺寸 analytical model 解析模型 johnson-mehl-avrami-kolmogorov (jmak) kinetics jmak动力学 columnar-to-equiaxed transition (cet) 柱状晶-等轴晶转变 visco-plastic self-consistent (vpsc) model 粘塑性自洽模型 texture simulation 织构模拟 scanning speed 扫描速度 microstructure prediction 微观结构预测 wei huang, xia ji, hamid garmestani, steven y. liang the international journal of advanced manufacturing technology george w. woodruff school of mechanical engineering, georgia institute of technology, 801 ferst drive, atlanta, 30332, ga, usa

blob: the influence of heat input on microstructure properties of wire arc additively manufactured ti-6al-4v alloy abstract titanium and its alloys are widely used in aerospace applications where weight is a critical constraint and high strength is essential. the aerospace components manufactured through conventional route is not productive due to the higher cost and long manufacturing process. wire arc additive manufacturing (waam) process is one of the prominent methods to produce the reliable components through additive techniques without wastage of materials and saving a lot of time for manufacturing. us 该论文研究了线弧增材制造ti-6al-4v合金的热输入对微观结构和拉伸性能的影响，但未涉及疲劳性能。 the paper focuses on tensile properties and microstructure control via heat input in waam, but does not provide fatigue characterization or s-n data, which are central to the evaluation focus. 探索waam工艺参数对ti-6al-4v合金微观结构和力学性能的影响。 通过改变热输入参数，研究waam沉积ti-6al-4v的微观组织演变和拉伸性能。 低热输入下形成混合等轴和柱状晶粒，高热输入下产生各向异性和粗大柱状晶粒。 通过拉伸测试和显微组织观察验证热输入对性能的影响。 waam ti-6al-4v heat input microstructure tensile strength anisotropy wire arc additive manufacturing (waam) 线弧增材制造 ti-6al-4v ti-6al-4v合金 heat input 热输入 grain morphology 晶粒形态 prior-β grains 初生β晶粒 equiaxed grains 等轴晶 columnar grains 柱状晶 anisotropic tensile strength 各向异性抗拉强度 muralimohan cheepu, ragavanantham shanmugam, lava kumar vandrangi vitzronextech co., ltd. , ,

blob: a dynamic time warping-transfer learning approach to transferring knowledge in stress-strain behaviors from polymers to metals: an affordable and generalizable additive manufacturing part qualification framework part qualification in additive manufacturing (am) ensures that additively manufactured parts can be consistently produced and reliably used in critical applications. one crucial aspect of part qualification is to determine the complex stress-strain behavior of additively manufactured parts. however, conventional part qualification techniques such as the destructive testing and non-destructive testing are costly and time consuming, especially for metal am. to address this challenge, we develop a  该论文主要关注一种通用的迁移学习方法，将聚合物应力应变知识转移到金属材料，ti6al4v仅作为其中一个测试案例，不专注于ti6al4v的力学或疲劳性能。 paper does not focus on ti-6al-4v mechanical/fatigue characterization; it uses ti-6al-4v as one of three test datasets for a general ml framework transferring knowledge from polymers to metals. 提出一种低成本增材制造部件鉴定方法，通过迁移聚合物知识预测金属应力应变。 利用动态时间规整选择最优聚合物数据集，训练lstm模型预测金属应力应变曲线。 在alsi10mg、ti6al4v和碳钢上取得良好预测精度（mape 12.41%）。 基于文献中的公开实验数据集进行数值验证。 dynamic time warping transfer learning stress-strain behavior additive manufacturing alsi10mg ti6al4v carbon steel lstm dynamic time warping 动态时间规整 transfer learning 迁移学习 stress-strain behavior 应力应变行为 lstm 长短期记忆网络 ti6al4v ti6al4v钛合金 additive manufacturing 增材制造 part qualification 部件鉴定 duan, chenglong, wu, dazhong arxiv.org
